title: HomeShield Discount Schedule and Discount Cap
content:
Homeowners Insurance premiums under the HomeShield programs carry six discounts, each stated as a percentage, and a cap on the sum of all discounts. The discount names below are the ones used throughout Calloway Insurance Agency rating.

## Discounts and what each one is for

| Discount | What it is for |
|---|---|
| New home discount | The first policy term of a newly completed home |
| Builder affiliate discount | A home financed through Calloway Home Mortgage |
| Bundle discount | An auto policy placed with Calloway Insurance Agency |
| Autopay discount | Automatic payments |
| Paid-in-full discount | Paying the term premium in full |
| Claims-free renewal discount | Renewal after the required number of claim-free years |

## Schedule by program

| Program | New home | Builder affiliate | Bundle | Autopay | Paid in full | Claims-free renewal | Claim-free years required | Cap on the sum of all discounts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 15 percent | 5 percent | 10 percent | 2 percent | 5 percent | 5 percent | 3 years | 30 percent |
| HomeShield Standard | 15 percent | 5 percent | 10 percent | 2 percent | 5 percent | 5 percent | 3 years | 30 percent |
| HomeShield Plus | 18 percent | 5 percent | 12 percent | 2 percent | 5 percent | 5 percent | 3 years | 32 percent |
| HomeShield Preferred | 18 percent | 5 percent | 12 percent | 2 percent | 5 percent | 7 percent | 3 years | 35 percent |
| HomeShield Premier | 20 percent | 5 percent | 15 percent | 2 percent | 5 percent | 7 percent | 3 years | 35 percent |
| HomeShield Estate | 20 percent | 5 percent | 15 percent | 2 percent | 5 percent | 10 percent | 3 years | 40 percent |

## The cap

The cap applies to the sum of all discounts, not to any single discount.

**Illustration (hypothetical set of discounts).** Under HomeShield Essential, a hypothetical sum of a 15 percent new home discount, a 5 percent builder affiliate discount, a 10 percent bundle discount and a 2 percent autopay discount comes to 32 percent; the cap of 30 percent limits the sum to 30 percent. The same four discounts under HomeShield Plus come to 18, 5, 12 and 2 percent, a sum of 37 percent, limited by that program's cap to 32 percent.

**Illustration below the cap.** Under HomeShield Estate, a hypothetical sum of a 5 percent builder affiliate discount and a 5 percent paid-in-full discount is 10 percent, well under the 40 percent cap, so the full 10 percent stands.
